text: I naturally take charge in group projects and enjoy guiding others toward a goal.
I prefer working independently and having full control over my own tasks.
I make decisions quickly based on my gut feeling rather than overanalyzing every detail.
I thrive in environments where every day looks different and there's always something new.
I value job stability and a predictable routine more than excitement or novelty.
I am motivated primarily by the impact of my work rather than financial rewards.
I enjoy mentoring or teaching others and sharing my knowledge.
I handle constructive criticism at work well and use it to improve.
I prefer roles where I can be creative rather than follow strict procedures.
I feel comfortable speaking up in meetings and advocating for my ideas.
